Priya S: Quick pulse — we need final owners + blockers for SDK/docs/sampleapps before changelog cutoff. Target cutoff: Tue Mar 30 18:00 UTC. Who's ✅?
Sam K: SDK: PRs merged except serialization one. @Ben L can you pick up review?
Ben L: On it, giving it a go today, should be green by EOD.
Chloe R: Docs: final pass done, waiting on sample snippets from sampleapp team.
Maya P: Sampleapps: failing e2e on windows; investigating. repro steps:
```
pytest tests/e2e/test_quickstart.py::test_create_example -k windows
```
Priya S: What's ETA on fix?
Maya P: Hoping for tomorrow morning. Might need docs to update snippets if we change CLI args.
Sam K: If sampleapp changes CLI, add compatibility notes in SDK changelog.
Alice V: I'll handle changelog bullets. Please ping me the exact CLI diff.
Ben L: review done, left 1 question inline.
Maya P: Sharing quick patch: `git diff --no-index old new` -> small arg rename; rolling out now.
devex-bot: CI pipeline report: sampleapps/e2e failing 1/15 jobs. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4591 :warning:
Priya S: Ok - plan: Ben finishes review today, Maya merges patch tomorrow, Sam will cut SDK RC with compatibility flag, Alice drafts changelog. If any of these slip, we delay cutoff by 24h. Acknowledgements?
Sam K: Ack. I'll schedule RC window 10:00 UTC.
Ben L: Ack, will finish EOD.
Alice V: Ack, drafting bullets, will tag for review.
Chloe R: Ack on docs updates ready to publish after sampleapp patch.
Maya P: Ack, will post PR link when ready.
Priya S: Thanks all. @devex-oncall FYI for release window. :thumbsup:
